Config.Clone promises a copy, and RawNode.Status promises current status; AutoLeave is an ordinary semantic Config field, with no stated redaction. getStatus invokes Clone directly. The omitted field in the returned literal therefore supplies a concrete suspected value-loss mechanism, independently of the comparison outcome. The fixed driver bootstraps empty MemoryStorage instances, elects node 1 through actual messages, proposes remove-3 via supported implicit/explicit joint transitions, and applies the committed entry. It persists entries and HardState before delivery, detaches message bytes, processes every committed configuration before Advance and permits no concurrent method calls. MemoryStorage is a faithful no-crash substitute in this scope. No direct state assignment, fabricated response, forced role or transfer setup is used.

The observation point is immediately after ApplyConfChange and before Advance. Both the returned ConfState and the private live tracker flag are measured; Status is then called with no intervening protocol operation. Automatic exit cannot race this serialized call. The direct Clone diagnostic is invoked only after Status and does not establish the expectation. The oracle is equality of the exported AutoLeave field and the actual input source field, justified by the copy/current-status contract, not equality with an assumed mode. Its single prerequisite is copy_admitted with joint=true, and its independent identity is case/operation/node/index/entry_term. There is exactly one matching result in each subtest for node 1 entry 5 term 2. No expected-value filter excludes either true or false mode; the compared value is not an identity field. All CA_EVENT records are complete and the test completed without prerequisite failure.

Actual implicit-mode admission has live and ApplyConfChange-return AutoLeave=true. Its result has Status.Config.AutoLeave=false and direct Clone=false, while live_after remains true; incoming voters [1,2] and outgoing voters [1,2,3] correspond to the same joint history. Explicit-mode admission and result both have false. Thus the implicit-mode comparison violates the field-preservation requirement and the false-mode control holds. A false control alone would not prove correctness, and the successful Go test exit is not the violation oracle. The copied flag does not imply active mode changed: live_after=true directly contradicts that broader interpretation. Changer.EnterJoint sets the requested mode after copying, and LeaveJoint deliberately clears it, so these alternative consumers do not independently show protocol-state corruption. No issue found in correspondence for the scoped public status value loss.

Follower validates the prior term/index and never overwrites committed entries; successful append responses and leader self acknowledgments wait for durable storage. Leader tracks Match per peer, aggregates only configured voters (both majorities in joint state), and commits a quorum-supported index only if it belongs to its term. Rejection, heartbeat retry and snapshot fallback repair lagging support.

Same-term leader traffic ends candidacy; old-term traffic cannot count as fresh replication support. Transfer temporarily blocks proposals, catches up its target and sends TimeoutNow; timeout clears transfer without changing role. Applying configuration updates quorum authority; snapshot/restart restore it.

connection.explanation: Eligible support depends jointly on current term and installed membership. Role reset discards volatile replication/vote support, but retained committed history restricts future vote eligibility and append acceptance. Joint membership requires old and new majorities; applying a configuration can itself make more entries quorum-supported. Deferred storage acknowledgments are qualified by term, with committed snapshot/application completions surviving authority change. Pending proposal success is not guaranteed; proposals during transfer are dropped. Safe read support is rebuilt after reset and gated on current-term commit; queued pre-commit requests are separately released later. Application of committed membership plus applied progress conditionally initiates automatic exit; proposal acceptance is still governed by current authority/transfer state.

items.rationale:
Reviewed fixed artifact 3a14b92a84ad47ddaaf66107babcb3b9 version 1 against O-auto-exit version 1 and execution c14ff92624034255a3f506d0795b2631. Applicability comes from tracker.Config automatic transition when possible, contrasted with manual explicit joint mode, and ConfChangeV2 implicit-mode selection. The driver uses real public RawNode bootstrap, campaign, proposal, Step, Ready, ApplyConfChange and Advance; it assigns no protocol fields. The actual entry at index 5 removes node 3 using implicit joint consensus, while node 1 and node 2 remain voters. It starts transfer after applying that entry but before acknowledging its Ready. This serialized interleaving is permitted by RawNode and is also representable in Node.run while waiting for Advance. Persistence precedes outgoing delivery; every committed entry is processed before Advance, and the no-crash MemoryStorage substitution is explicit. Only TimeoutNow is lost; the actual trace contains one such drop before cancellation. Removed-peer replies are logged admission rejections, not suppressed results.

The monitor has one unique cycle_admitted prerequisite and one cycle_result for the stable independent identity (case, operation, leader, joint_index). The admission reports live AutoLeave true, three outgoing voters, leader state and transfer zero with queues empty. The result retains actual full state before/after, not an expected result. Independently reassembled Go output by test stream and parsed the complete JSON records; the two captured states compare equal. The implication repeat_cycle => !joint_pending is false because both repeat_cycle and joint_pending are true. This is a closed-cycle witness for the automatic-continuation obligation, not an assertion that 30 ticks is a deadline. The test stops after fixed work independently of the property. The source history and configuration_applied records establish the same joint entry and transfer producer; no constructed peer response substitutes for it.

State coverage includes all RawNode fields, all raft fields except logging sinks, reachable log/unstable and MemoryStorage bytes, membership and progress/inflight state, pending reads, deferred replies and stepsOnAdvance. At both endpoints all three logs have committed=applying=applied=5, unstable entries/snapshot empty, application size zero and stable offset 6. Leader Match for all peers is 5 with no outstanding inflights; messages and transport are empty. All nodes retain term 2, followers have electionElapsed zero, and leader has both clocks zero. Capture excludes MemoryStorage.callStats: their source uses only increment diagnostic access counters, never decision inputs. Logging sinks do not control this normal path; tracing is disabled by the build-selected nop implementation. Slice capacity and pointer addresses are allocation details on this suffix; live contents, nilness and field structure are retained, and the same node instances/closure receivers persist.

The repeating schedule ticks all three nodes once then drains all Ready and FIFO transport; sorted tracker.Visit makes broadcasts deterministic. Each follower's tick reaches elapsed 1, below its captured randomized timeout (17 or 18), and the delivered heartbeat resets it to zero. Leader heartbeats recur every tick and CheckQuorum every ten; responses keep both joint majorities active. The leader's captured randomized timeout is 14 but is not used by tickHeartbeat. No role reset occurs on this suffix, so the only random producer, resetRandomizedElectionTimeout, is not called. There are no read requests, stale replies, snapshots or storage callbacks left to alter future transitions. Ordinary heartbeat Readys contain no committed entries, so Advance schedules no appliedTo retry. abortLeaderTransfer clears the target but schedules no exit. Thus repetition can continue under complete required service without unrelated proposals or forced elections.

The no-transfer control exits at index 6. The diagnostic proposal after the measured suffix commits an ordinary entry at 6 and an automatic exit at 7. These are contrary evidence to broad unavailability, but corroborate that the joint quorum works and application progress supplies the missing trigger. Exported Status.Config.AutoLeave is false because Clone omits it; the checker deliberately reads live tracker state and the full capture, so it does not confuse that separate reporting discrepancy with loss of the live mode. Reviewed fixed artifact 3a14b92a84ad47ddaaf66107babcb3b9 version 1 against O-auto-exit version 1 and execution c14ff92624034255a3f506d0795b2631. Applicability comes from tracker.Config automatic transition when possible, contrasted with manual explicit joint mode, and ConfChangeV2 implicit-mode selection. The driver uses real public RawNode bootstrap, campaign, proposal, Step, Ready, ApplyConfChange and Advance; it assigns no protocol fields. The actual entry at index 5 removes node 3 using implicit joint consensus, while node 1 and node 2 remain voters. It starts transfer after applying that entry but before acknowledging its Ready. This serialized interleaving is permitted by RawNode and is also representable in Node.run while waiting for Advance. Persistence precedes outgoing delivery; every committed entry is processed before Advance, and the no-crash MemoryStorage substitution is explicit. Only TimeoutNow is lost; the actual trace contains one such drop before cancellation. Removed-peer replies are logged admission rejections, not suppressed results.

The monitor has one unique cycle_admitted prerequisite and one cycle_result for the stable independent identity (case, operation, leader, joint_index). The admission reports live AutoLeave true, three outgoing voters, leader state and transfer zero with queues empty. The result retains actual full state before/after, not an expected result. Independently reassembled Go output by test stream and parsed the complete JSON records; the two captured states compare equal. The implication repeat_cycle => !joint_pending is false because both repeat_cycle and joint_pending are true. This is a closed-cycle witness for the automatic-continuation obligation, not an assertion that 30 ticks is a deadline. The test stops after fixed work independently of the property. The source history and configuration_applied records establish the same joint entry and transfer producer; no constructed peer response substitutes for it.

State coverage includes all RawNode fields, all raft fields except logging sinks, reachable log/unstable and MemoryStorage bytes, membership and progress/inflight state, pending reads, deferred replies and stepsOnAdvance. At both endpoints all three logs have committed=applying=applied=5, unstable entries/snapshot empty, application size zero and stable offset 6. Leader Match for all peers is 5 with no outstanding inflights; messages and transport are empty. All nodes retain term 2, followers have electionElapsed zero, and leader has both clocks zero. Capture excludes MemoryStorage.callStats: their source uses only increment diagnostic access counters, never decision inputs. Logging sinks do not control this normal path; tracing is disabled by the build-selected nop implementation. Slice capacity and pointer addresses are allocation details on this suffix; live contents, nilness and field structure are retained, and the same node instances/closure receivers persist.

The repeating schedule ticks all three nodes once then drains all Ready and FIFO transport; sorted tracker.Visit makes broadcasts deterministic. Each follower's tick reaches elapsed 1, below its captured randomized timeout (17 or 18), and the delivered heartbeat resets it to zero. Leader heartbeats recur every tick and CheckQuorum every ten; responses keep both joint majorities active. The leader's captured randomized timeout is 14 but is not used by tickHeartbeat. No role reset occurs on this suffix, so the only random producer, resetRandomizedElectionTimeout, is not called. There are no read requests, stale replies, snapshots or storage callbacks left to alter future transitions. Ordinary heartbeat Readys contain no committed entries, so Advance schedules no appliedTo retry. abortLeaderTransfer clears the target but schedules no exit. Thus repetition can continue under complete required service without unrelated proposals or forced elections.

The no-transfer control exits at index 6. The diagnostic proposal after the measured suffix commits an ordinary entry at 6 and an automatic exit at 7. These are contrary evidence to broad unavailability, but corroborate that the joint quorum works and application progress supplies the missing trigger. Exported Status.Config.AutoLeave is false because Clone omits it; the checker deliberately reads live tracker state and the full capture, so it does not confuse that separate reporting discrepancy with loss of the live mode. No issue found in correspondence for this scoped witness; wider scheduling and safety claims are not established.
